I agree with 'present' but note the uncertainty. The handle and rim checkpoints are correctly marked as present.
artifact_review: The Router identified a texture anomaly in the liquid contents (severity 2.5). The Perceptual Quality Auditor downplayed this as 'slight blur' (0.2), likely missing the semantic weirdness of the 'waxy' solids. I agree with the Router that the contents look unnatural/plastic-like, which is a common AI artifact in fluid simulations. The Topology Auditor's mask confidence (0.974) confirms the cup/handle structure is coherent, ruling out major fusion issues there. The background blur is aesthetic, not an artifact. I will maintain the severity of the content anomaly at ~2.5 as it detracts from the realism of the 'beverage' context.
alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'cup' class. All testable structural checkpoints (handle, rim, glaze, pattern) are met. The only deduction is for the slight ambiguity of the body shape due to framing, but it fits the taxonomy well.

This is a moderate artifact (severity ~2.5) because it breaks the photorealism of the beverage. The rest of the image (ceramic body, handle) is structurally sound and free of melting/fusion artifacts, supported by the high topology mask score. The background blur is intentional depth-of-field.
